# Comparison

How one extraction became another: correspondence, status, optional summaries and presentation order. Never positions, colors or timing. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/comparison/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/comparison/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/comparison/v0.json).

## Document

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `protocolVersion` | `0` | Yes |  |
| `changes` | array of [`change`](#change) | Yes | At most 120000 items. |
| `steps` | [`steps`](#steps) | Yes |  |
| `order` | object |  |  |
| `order.reverse` | `"mirror"` or `"explicit"` | Yes |  |
| `reverseSteps` | [`steps`](#steps) |  |  |
| `variation` | object |  | Present exactly when a change has `varied`. |
| `variation.within` | integer | Yes | Unchanged changes with `varied`: variation within tolerance only. At least 0. |
| `variation.beyond` | integer | Yes | Modified changes with at least one `varied` value beyond tolerance. At least 0. |
| `metadata` | [`data`](extraction.md#data) |  |  |

No other properties are allowed.

Further rules depend on these values; see the JSON Schema for them.

## Definitions

### `text`

Type: string. At least 1 character.

### `ids`

Type: array of [`text`](#text). At most 60000 items. Items are unique.

### `varied`

One volatile value that differs between a matched pair.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | [`text`](#text) | Yes | The concrete pointer into the item, under `/data/`. |
| `within` | boolean | Yes | Whether the difference is within the declared tolerance. |
| `reason` | [`text`](#text) |  | Why a tolerance couldn't be applied: only when a spread was unavailable and no other bound held, or a generated value is on one side only. |
| `generated` | `true` |  | A generated value, judged by its basis: within exactly when the bases are equal. |
| `because` | array of [`text`](#text) |  | A generated value's basis parts that differ, in UTF-16 order; absent when the bases are equal. At least 1 item. Items are unique. |

No other properties are allowed.

### `change`

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | [`text`](#text) | Yes | Unique within the comparison: by convention the first after ID, or the before ID for removals. |
| `collection` | `"entities"` or `"relationships"` | Yes |  |
| `before` | [`ids`](#ids) | Yes |  |
| `after` | [`ids`](#ids) | Yes |  |
| `status` | `"added"` or `"removed"` or `"modified"` or `"unchanged"` | Yes |  |
| `correspondence` | `"exact"` or `"declared"` or `"split"` or `"merge"` or `"none"` | Yes |  |
| `varied` | array of [`varied`](#varied) |  | The volatile values that differ, sorted by path; present exactly when one does. Only on `exact` and `declared` changes. An `exact` change whose every difference is within is `unchanged` and belongs to no step. At least 1 item. At most 60000 items. |
| `summary` | [`text`](#text) |  |  |

No other properties are allowed.

### `step`

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `changes` | array of [`text`](#text) | Yes | At least 1 item. At most 120000 items. Items are unique. |
| `kind` | `"remove"` or `"restructure"` or `"add"` |  |  |
| `summary` | [`text`](#text) |  |  |

No other properties are allowed.

### `steps`

Type: array of [`step`](#step). At most 120000 items.

## Examples

[Custom comparators: what they make possible](../../guides/comparators.md) shows comparisons made by real
comparators, each drawn beside the default comparison of the same change:

- [Domain verdicts](../../guides/comparators.md#domain-verdicts-runtime-security-policies): runtime security
  policy changes interpreted as Scope broadened, Newly enforced and No longer covered.
- [Classification](../../guides/comparators.md#classification-api-compatibility): API changes classified as
  breaking, additive or compatible, which a workflow can gate on.
- [Identity](../../guides/comparators.md#identity-renames-moves-splits-and-merges): a component moved between
  modules declared as one item, not one removed and another added.
- [Order](../../guides/comparators.md#order-telling-the-change-in-the-right-sequence): steps told by severity
  instead of by structure.
